authoritative_for: Clew owns user-reported application statuses and arbitrary notes in an append-only ledger, current/history reads, exact retry identity, corrections and its program installation.
not_authoritative_for: The user supplies status and resolves ambiguity with the agent. Platter owns prepared opportunity identity and packets.

covers: All public Clew outcomes for initialization, local integrity checking, candidate finding, reported status/notes, current/history reads, retraction and installation.
excludes: Help/version, implementation helpers, automatic interpretation, job discovery, application submission, employer contact and scheduling.

shared_access_and_trust: The current user and their authorized agent invoke the local CLI. A search result does not authorize a write.
shared_privacy_and_retention: Ledger entries and output are private. Entries are retained indefinitely without automatic pruning. Usage observation contains only command identity and task correlation, not arguments or content.
compatibility_and_retirement: Database schema one and output schema one are independent of provider release. Unsupported state fails without implicit migration.
operational_limits: Clew is an on-demand CLI. Full reads scale with retained history; no hard size or latency guarantee is supplied.
